parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human adenosine A3 receptor in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for 'adenosine A3 receptor' and target_dictionary.organism for 'Homo sapiens'. Filter assays.assay_organism for 'Homo sapiens'. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Alias the molecule identifier as compound_chembl_id. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
